sentences.en: So, I just want to begin with the observation that it's genuinely surprising, at least to me, that we are still living with and talking about this outbreak,
sentences.zh: 我想先指出一点，至少对我而言，我们竟然还在经历并谈论这场疫情，这着实令人惊讶，

sentences.en: because it began in June, late June, but June, and it's still somehow expanding.
sentences.zh: 因为它始于六月，六月下旬，但确实是六月，而且它至今不知为何仍在蔓延。

sentences.en: How can that be?
sentences.zh: 怎么会这样？

sentences.en: Yeah, this really is expanding.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实在蔓延。

sentences.en: So in a typical year, you would see about 3,000 cases of cyclospora done.
sentences.zh: 所以在典型的一年里，你会看到大约3,000起环孢子虫病例。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But right now, we're in August, and federal officials are still looking at 10,000 confirmed,
sentences.zh: 但现在我们正处于八月，联邦官员仍在统计10,000起确诊病例，

sentences.en: 12,000 possible.
sentences.zh: 12,000起疑似病例。

sentences.en: So you're looking at potentially at 22,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 所以你面对的潜在病例可能高达22,000起。

sentences.en: Which is, from your math, seven times a normal year's worth of outbreak.
sentences.zh: 按照你们的计算，这相当于正常年份疫情规模的七倍。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But you can see why this would pile up.
sentences.zh: 但你可以理解为什么病例会像滚雪球一样越积越多。

sentences.en: For one, you do your typical washing procedure at your kitchen sink, that's not going to kill the cyclospora.
sentences.zh: 首先，你在厨房水槽里按照常规清洗程序洗菜，根本杀不死环孢子虫。

sentences.en: I mean, you can't kill it by cooking it, but, I mean, who's cooking their iceberg lettuce, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你通过烹饪可以杀死它，但是，谁会去煮自己的冰山生菜呢，对吧？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And it's been on the shelf for a while.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经在货架上放了一段时间了。

sentences.en: The lettuce that was potentially infected, that was good all the way out through August 3rd.
sentences.zh: 那些可能被污染的生菜，保质期一直持续到8月3日。

sentences.en: So you're just now starting to see that get a little brown and mushy in the back of the fridge.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在才刚开始看到它们在冰箱角落里变得有点发棕、发烂。

sentences.en: So for the cases to continue popping up is really not that surprising.
sentences.zh: 因此，病例不断涌现其实一点也不足为奇。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: And it can take weeks after you consume something contaminated with cyclospora to start feeling symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 而且在食用被环孢子虫污染的东西几周后，你才开始感觉到症状。

sentences.en: Scientists call this a long incubation period.
sentences.zh: 科学家称之为漫长的潜伏期。

sentences.en: So you might not even start to have the diarrhea until a couple weeks after eating the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能在吃下东西几周后才开始出现腹泻。

sentences.en: And then after that, you might not go to the doctor to get your stool sampled and tested for cyclospora for another few weeks.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，你可能又要过好几周才会去看医生并采集大便样本进行环孢子虫检测。

sentences.en: So this can be really a long process from when somebody eats the contaminated thing to when they get diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 因此，从某人吃下受污染的食物到被确诊，这确实是一个漫长的过程。

sentences.en: And then there's even more time between that diagnosis and when a public health official would officially report the case.
sentences.zh: 而且，从确诊到公共卫生官员正式报告该病例之间，还有更多的时间间隔。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So there's a long tail to this.
sentences.zh: 所以这有一个很长的尾效。

sentences.en: And based on what you just said, Christina, people may just be getting around to eating the lettuce that makes them sick.
sentences.zh: 根据你刚才所说的话，克里斯蒂娜，人们可能刚刚开始吃那些让他们生病的生菜。

sentences.en: So this is going to be with us for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以这个问题还会伴随我们一段时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, this could laSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，这可能会持续下去。

sentences.en: Well, the reason you're both here is because you've somewhat unwillingly become authorities on this outbreak.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你们俩今天之所以来到这里，是因为你们有些情非得以地成为了这场疫情的权威专家。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how the outbreak has played out, what we've learned about its origins, and ultimately what we've learned about our food safety system in the process.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈这场疫情是如何发展的，我们对它的起源有了什么了解，以及在此过程中我们对食品安全系统最终有了什么认识。

sentences.en: So where does this outbreak begin?
sentences.zh: 那么这场疫情是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So this begins across the country, but mostly in the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 这场疫情始于全国各地，但主要集中在中西部。

sentences.en: Back in the beginning of the summer, people started to report severe diarrhea, and stool sample testing showed that it was this parasite, cyclospora.
sentences.zh: 早在夏初，人们开始报告严重的腹泻，大便样本检测显示罪魁祸首正是这种名为环孢子虫的寄生虫。

sentences.en: And more and more cases began to mount, which got the attention of state public health agencies, followed by the CDC.
sentences.zh: 病例开始越来越多，这引起了州公共卫生机构的注意，随后疾控中心（CDC）也介入了。

sentences.en: And on July 14th, the CDC officially announced it's opening an investigation into this outbreak.
sentences.zh: 7月14日，疾控中心正式宣布对这场疫情展开调查。

sentences.en: And this is the moment where all of us are like, cyclo, huh?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所有人都觉得：环孢什么，哈？

sentences.en: Like, tell us about this parasite.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这种寄生虫吧。

sentences.en: This is a parasite that spreads through food or water that's just, I'll just say it, it's contaminated by human feces.
sentences.zh: 这是一种通过食物或水传播的寄生虫，我就直说了吧，它是被人类粪便污染的。

sentences.en: So that's pretty much the only way that it spreads, at least that scientists are aware of.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎是它传播的唯一途径，至少是科学家们所知道的途径。

sentences.en: So somewhere, somehow, there's a food source that has human fecal matter on it.
sentences.zh: 因此，不知何故，在某个地方，有一种食物源上面带有人类粪便残留物。

sentences.en: Somebody eats it, and this parasite, it enters the body in these little pods called oocysts.
sentences.zh: 有人吃了它，这种寄生虫便以被称为卵囊的小囊状结构进入人体。

sentences.en: Oocysts, and they're kind of like eggs.
sentences.zh: 卵囊，它们有点像卵。

sentences.en: But they make their way down into the intestines where they burrow into the wall of the intestine, and the parasite emerges from these oocysts
sentences.zh: 但它们会一路进入肠道，在那里钻进肠壁，寄生虫从这些卵囊中破壳而出，

sentences.en: and starts to infect the cells that line your intestine.
sentences.zh: 并开始感染排列在你肠道内壁的细胞。

sentences.en: And so this whole process can take anywhere from a few days to two weeks as this parasite comes out of these little oocysts and begins to reproduce first, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以整个过程可能需要几天到两周的时间，当这种寄生虫从这些小卵囊中出来并开始繁殖时，首先，你知道的，

sentences.en: just asexual reproduction.
sentences.zh: 只是无性繁殖。

sentences.en: Then it's reproducing sexually, so with each other, and just exponentially, there's more and more and more of these.
sentences.zh: 然后它们进行有性繁殖，也就是彼此结合，呈指数级增长，越来越多的寄生虫滋生。

sentences.en: I totally neglected the trigger warning that was required to have this conversation because now we're talking about sexual reproduction of a parasite in our bodies.
sentences.zh: 我完全忘了进行这场对话所需的触发警告，因为现在我们在讨论寄生虫在我们体内的有性繁殖。

sentences.en: Okay, but I need you to keep going, sadly.
sentences.zh: 好吧，但很遗憾，我需要你继续讲下去。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So at that point when these cyclospora parasites have infected your intestinal walls to the degree that you can't absorb the nutrients
sentences.zh: 那么，当这些环孢子虫寄生虫严重感染了你的肠壁，以至于你无法吸收你所吃进和喝下的营养物质

sentences.en: and the fluids that you're eating and drinking, that's when you start to see this really, really bad diarrhea that people describe as explosive, debilitating.
sentences.zh: 和水分时，你就会开始出现这种非常非常严重的腹泻，人们将其描述为爆发性的、使人虚弱的腹泻。

sentences.en: They can't go to work.
sentences.zh: 他们无法去上班。

sentences.en: They can't go to birthday parties.
sentences.zh: 他们无法去参加生日派对。

sentences.en: They're just sitting on their toilet, and they're miserable.
sentences.zh: 他们只能坐在马桶上，痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: It's a very nasty parasite.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常恶劣的寄生虫。

sentences.en: And as you said, if you've somehow gotten cyclospora, you have somehow ingested remnants of human fecal matter.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，如果你不知怎么感染了环孢子虫，说明你不知怎么摄入了人类粪便的残余物。

sentences.en: So I'm guessing it's at this moment that the race begins to figure out how on earth that fecal matter got on food.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，正是在这个时候，人们开始争分夺秒地弄清楚这些粪便究竟是怎么沾到食物上的。

sentences.en: So, Christina, maybe pick up the story from there.
sentences.zh: 那么，克里斯蒂娜，也许你可以从这里接着往下讲。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this is where epidemiology comes in.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是流行病学派上用场的时候了。

sentences.en: You have state public health officials, local officials.
sentences.zh: 你会遇到州公共卫生官员、地方官员。

sentences.en: They want to do a 90-minute interview with you.
sentences.zh: 他们想对你进行长达90分钟的访谈。

sentences.en: They want to know everything you ate weeks ago, especially fresh, raw produce that maybe hasn't been washed.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道你在几周前吃过的一切，尤其是那些可能没有洗干净的新鲜生食农产品。

sentences.en: They want your loyalty, you know, number for the grocery stores where you shop routinely.
sentences.zh: 他们想要你在经常购物的杂货店的会员卡号。

sentences.en: They're going through the Safeway shopping records.
sentences.zh: 他们正在仔细查阅西夫韦（Safeway）的购物记录。

sentences.en: Yeah, and they want to know what's on your credit card and your debit card, if you ate at Taco Bell, if you ate at Subway, where you ate.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们想知道你的信用卡和借记卡上有什么消费记录，你是否在塔可钟（Taco Bell）吃过饭，是否在赛百味（Subway）吃过，你在哪里吃过。

sentences.en: And they do these interviews with dozens and dozens of people, and they're looking for commonalities.
sentences.zh: 他们对几十个人进行了这样的访谈，并在其中寻找共同点。

sentences.en: They want to create a big Venn diagram and see, you know, exactly what pops out.
sentences.zh: 他们想要创建一个大型维恩图，看看究竟能得出什么结论。

sentences.en: And where does that Venn diagram ultimately point?
sentences.zh: 那个维恩图最终指向了哪里？

sentences.en: So these interviews are tricky because few people can remember exactly what they ate for, you know, weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以这些访谈很棘手，因为很少有人能准确记住自己在几周前吃过什么。

sentences.en: And if they do remember, they might remember, I had a taco, not I had a taco with shredded iceberg lettuce and cilantro and peppers.
sentences.zh: 即使他们记得，他们也可能只记得“我吃过塔可”，而不是“我吃过加了切碎的冰山生菜、香菜和辣椒的塔可”。

sentences.en: But with enough of these interviews, you can sort of start to tease that out.
sentences.zh: 但通过足够多的此类访谈，你基本上可以把这些线索一点点理清。

sentences.en: And that's how investigators landed on shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, grown in Mexico, sold at Taco Bell.
sentences.zh: 这就是调查人员将目标锁定在泰勒农场（Taylor Farms）墨西哥种植、在塔可钟出售的切碎冰山生菜上的原因。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I think we should focus on Taylor Farms because it seems they're the distributor of this food.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该把重点放在泰勒农场上，因为他们似乎是这种食品的经销商。

sentences.en: But tell us everything you know about Taylor FarMs.
sentences.zh: 但请把你知道关于泰勒农场的一切都告诉我们。

sentences.en: Taylor Farms is a huge company, very, very big in fresh produce.
sentences.zh: 泰勒农场是一家庞大的公司，在新鲜农产品领域规模非常非常大。

sentences.en: They have contract growers all around the country, outside the country in Mexico as well.
sentences.zh: 他们在全国各地以及国外的墨西哥都有合同种植户。

sentences.en: And essentially, they ship bags of shredded lettuce
